versions.subject: feat: add rules related to scheduled tasks
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 129 # Created Task Process
    Path|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - 'C:\Temp\'
        # Add more suspicious LOLBINs below
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\calc.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe'
# If you experience FP. Uncomment the filter below and add the specific TaskName with the Program to it
#filter:
#    TaskName: '\Exact\Task\Name'
#    Path: 'Exact\Path'
condition: selection
